blocks.text: This Vehicle Consignment Agreement ("Consignment Agreement") is made as of {{consignment_date}} between:

rows: {{minimum_price}} — Dealer cannot sell below this price without Owner's written consent.

blocks.text: Owner grants Dealer the exclusive right to sell the Vehicle on Owner's behalf for {{consignment_term}} days (the "Consignment Period"), from {{consignment_start_date}} to {{consignment_end_date}}.

Dealer may list the Vehicle on its lot, website, and third-party marketplaces (AutoTrader, Cars.com, etc.). Dealer may set the listing price up to {{listing_price_max}} or {{listing_price_percent}}% above the asking price.

rows: Paid from sale proceeds at closing.
Deducted from sale proceeds if Dealer performs reconditioning.
If Dealer cleans the Vehicle before sale.
If Consignment Period is extended by mutual agreement.

blocks.text: When the Vehicle sells, proceeds are distributed in this order:
Dealer provides Owner with a settlement statement within {{settlement_statement_days}} days of sale. Net proceeds paid to Owner by {{payment_method}} within {{payment_timeline}} of sale closing.

items: Owner is the legal owner with full authority to consign the Vehicle.
The Vehicle is free of all liens. If there is an outstanding loan, Owner has disclosed the lender and loan balance.
Owner will deliver a valid title to Dealer. If there is an outstanding loan, Owner will provide a lien release or pay off the loan before sale.
Owner has disclosed all known material defects to Dealer.
The Vehicle has not been declared a total loss, salvaged, or flooded (unless disclosed).

blocks.text: Dealer sells the Vehicle "as-is" on behalf of Owner. Owner makes no warranties to the buyer, except any warranties explicitly stated in the sale documents. Dealer is not responsible for the Vehicle's condition.

Owner will deliver the Vehicle to Dealer at {{dealer_location}} on or before {{vehicle_delivery_date}}. At delivery, Dealer will inspect and note the Vehicle's condition on a delivery checklist. Owner acknowledges the condition noted at delivery.

Dealer handles DMV paperwork for the sale: title transfer, registration, and tax collection from the buyer. Dealer remits title to Buyer after sale. Owner receives net proceeds after all fees and commissions are deducted.

Owner maintains insurance on the Vehicle until sale closing. If the Vehicle is damaged while in Dealer's possession, Owner's insurance is primary. Dealer's insurance covers damage caused by Dealer's negligence.

items: Either Party may terminate with {{termination_notice}} days written notice.
If Owner terminates, Owner must pick up the Vehicle within {{pickup_period}} days. Fees already incurred are not refundable.
If Dealer terminates, Dealer must return the Vehicle to Owner or hold it for Owner's pickup.
If the Vehicle does not sell by the end of the Consignment Period, the Parties may agree to extend.

blocks.text: This Agreement is governed by the laws of {{governing_state}}.
